intendedUse: Combine four category improvement scores into one overall improvement relative to the current Bradley IFV.

limitations.justification: It matches CBO's published construction, which combines the categories by a weighting scheme and nothing else (pp. 33–34).
limitations.statement: Additive: no interaction between the categories.

limitations.justification: CBO combines the percentages directly; introducing a normalisation would change the published numbers.
limitations.statement: The value function is the identity on CBO's percentage scale.

name: CBO's overall-improvement metric (additive, four weighted categories)
